title: Raj Kumar Shukla v. Poorvanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd. and 2 Others
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Suneet Kumar, J. and Rajendra Kumar-IV, J.
disposition: Writ disposed with liberty to seek mutation under clause 7.7.5.
headnote: Where the registered consumer has died, a person seeking restoration of supply must first get his name mutated in respect of the premises under clause 7.7.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. A writ complaining that the licensee had not replaced a damaged meter was disposed of with liberty to take that remedy under the Code.
facts: Raj Kumar Shukla approached the Allahabad High Court complaining that Poorvanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd. was not replacing a damaged meter at the premises for which he sought restoration of electricity supply. Counsel for the licensee, on instruction, stated that the registered consumer of those premises had died. The petitioner pressed the meter grievance in his own name while the connection remained in the name of the deceased consumer.

reusable_constructions.construction: On the death of the registered consumer, mutation of the claimant's name under clause 7.7.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 is the first step toward restoration of supply, and a writ complaining of non-replacement of a damaged meter is disposed of with liberty to pursue that Code remedy.

holding_units.topic: Mutation before restoration where the registered consumer has died
holding_units.holding: Where the registered consumer has died, the person seeking restoration of electricity supply to the premises must, in the first instance, get his name mutated under clause 7.7.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. The writ seeking replacement of the damaged meter is disposed of with liberty to take the remedy under the Code.

principle_tags.application: The registered consumer having died, the Court required the petitioner to obtain mutation of his name under clause 7.7.5 before restoration of supply, and disposed of the damaged-meter writ with liberty to proceed under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005.

not_decided.point: Whether the petitioner is entitled to mutation and to replacement of the damaged meter
not_decided.note: Left to the remedy under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005, after the petitioner seeks mutation of his name.
